subject: English
guide_solution: Paragraph writing Price Giving Ceremony of My School It was the end of our First Terminal Exam when the annual prize giving ceremony of our school was held. We had been waiting for this day eagerly. So, it created great enthusiasm among the students. It was the month of May and all of us took active part in the month long programme of the annual sports and cultural functions. A big rostrum was built in front of our school building. The reotrum was beutifully covered with cloth. A nice gate was built at the entrance. The way leading to the rostrum was decorated with flowers and festoons. Sitting arrangement was made in front of the rostrum. Before the biginning of the main programme, the headmaster, the chief guest, the teachers, the guardians and other invited guests took their respective seats. The honourable minister of education was the chief guest at the function. The headmaster of our school presided over the ceremony. The function started at about 11.00 am. The chief guest gave a speech which was very valuable for all of us. Then the prize giving ceremony began. I won three prizes: one for recitation, one for debating and the other for high jump. I got two books and a beutiful pen as prizes. After the function I felt elated because I had never won so many prizes at any function. It was a memorable day for me. It inspired me to work hard to attain success in sports and academic activities. I will never forget the last annual prize giving day of our school.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 97 — Chittagong Govt. High School

subject: English
guide_solution: Story writing Abdur Rahman was a day labourer. He lived in a village in Cox's Bazar district. By working hard all days the lived hand to mouth. Because he had a large family. One day while he was working in a paddy field, a man called him. The man told him that he would lead a happy life if he would go to Malaysia. The man also offered him to send there without money. He would pay the money after reaching there. Abdur Rahman felt tempted and decided to go to Malaysia. In a few weeks he went to Malaysia and got a good job there. He earned handsome money and sent them for his family. His wife invested a big amount of money in the field buying some plots of land. She cared of the lands by man. After five years Abdur Rahman came to his country and became a landlord. He grows paddy, jute and vegetables in his fields. As a result, now he is a happy man in his village.  Title : Industry is the key to success
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 97 — Chittagong Govt. High School
